new_libraries.name: NuaSense
new_libraries.author: NuaSense <info@nuasense.com>
new_libraries.sentence: IoT weather station and soil moisture library for ESP32 and ESP8266: NuaSense grades how accurate your sensors are (A to D) and turns your readings into frost, irrigation and crop disease risk answers.
new_libraries.paragraph: For DIY weather stations and for garden, farm, greenhouse, beehive and storage monitoring. One add() per value, one send() per upload, over HTTPS with the certificate checked. In return: a data quality check for every sensor, frost tonight, spray windows, irrigation need and crop disease risk for your location. Works with any sensor you can read, for example BME280, DHT22, SHT31 or a capacitive soil moisture probe.

library.name: RCLink
library.author: Little Man Builds (Darren Osborne)
library.sentence: Validated RC receiver mapping for Arduino with iBUS, ESP32 SBUS, shaping, filtering, and failsafe handling.
library.paragraph: RCLink maps receiver channels into named application roles with calibrated asymmetric axes, deterministic switches, explicit channel validity, link health, failsafe signatures, resilient stream parsers, optional JSON configuration, and an iBUS calibration helper. The core mapping and parsers are hardware-neutral and host-testable; SBUS transport is ESP32-specific.

library.name: TinyUPnP
library.author: Ofek Pearl <ofekpearl@gmail.com>
library.sentence: Add port mappings to your router automatically
library.paragraph: UPnP implementation for embedded application that allows you to add automatic port mappings (port forwarding). You can also install EasyDDNS library as a supplement for accessing your device from the internet without using its explicit IP address.
